ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム』ＭＳＶ（モビルスーツバリエーション）から、人気のジュアッグが遂にHGUCシリーズに登場！
当時のＭＳＶの設定画に存在した姿を再現！
●特徴的な右腕は近接戦用にゾゴックタイプの腕に換装され、アクション用の装備としてヒート・ナイフが付属！
左腕のキャノンの内部モールドは、大口径ロケット弾タイプに。
●右腕の手首は平手のほか、ヒート・ナイフ用のグリップが付属
●アッガイを意識したベーシックなカラーリングの成形色を採用
●ＭＳＶ特有の階級マークやナンバーが入ったマーキングが新規シールとして付属！！
付属武装 ： ヒート・ナイフ

en: The popular Juag from "Mobile Suit Gundam" MSV (Mobile Suit Variation) has finally appeared in the HGUC series!
Reproduce the appearance that existed in the MSV setting picture at the time!
-The characteristic right arm has been replaced with a Zogok type arm for close combat, and a heat knife is included as action equipment!
The internal mold of the left arm cannon is a large caliber rocket type.
-In addition to the palm of the right arm, a grip for the heat knife is included.
-Adopts a basic molding color with Acguy in mind.
●Marking with MSV-specific class marks and numbers is included as a new Seal! !
Attached weapon: Heat knife
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo is a painted prototype. The actual product may differ slightly.
*This product is not a camouflage color molded color like the MSV setting picture.
